thread:
ada: Quick heads-up — after today's model bring-up (redwood-v2.1) + int8 quant, the multilingual eval shows odd regressions.

kai: Which langs? numbers please.

eval-bot: Ran eval job 1763649000 on dataset multilingual-200k-pairs.
Results (char-level BLEU / BERTScore / avg tok length vs baseline):
```
lang  | BLEU_new -> BLEU_base | BERT_new -> BERT_base | avg_tok_len_new -> base
zh-cn | 12.4 -> 21.8          | 0.68 -> 0.75          | 47 -> 33 (+42%)
ja    | 14.1 -> 22.9          | 0.70 -> 0.76          | 39 -> 28 (+39%)
ko    | 20.7 -> 21.9          | 0.72 -> 0.73          | 31 -> 29 (+7%)
ar    | 18.9 -> 19.4          | 0.71 -> 0.72          | 34 -> 33 (+3%)
he    | 16.5 -> 16.8          | 0.69 -> 0.70          | 33 -> 33 (0%)
en    | 26.2 -> 27.0          | 0.79 -> 0.80          | 24 -> 24 (0%)
```

yuki: Those avg token length increases for CJK are suspicious — looks like tokenizer mismatch. Did we swap vocab or use a different SentencePiece model during the quantized build?

ada: I checked the build logs: tokenizer artifact used for quantized image is `tokenizer_sp_v2_16k` while baseline used `tokenizer_sp_v3_32k`. That explains length blow-up for zh/ja.

kai: So two simultaneous changes: new model checkpoint + smaller vocab tokenizer + int8 quant. Hard to attribute.

marta: Product needs severity: is this user-visible? Translation demos on staging show many truncated sentences for zh/ja and broken punctuation in arabic outputs.

yuki: Also noted RTL issues: Arabic outputs have mirrored punctuation and dropped tashkeel diacritics in some cases. Suspect BiDi handling: we may be normalizing unicode differently in tokenizer post-processing.

ada: Re-ran quick eval forcing `--tokenizer path/to/tokenizer_sp_v3_32k` with same quantized model. BLEU for zh-cn jumped back to 20.9 (near baseline). So primary culprit = tokenizer mismatch. Quantization still causes small drops but not the large ones.

eval-bot: New quick-run results attached: zh-cn 20.9, ja 21.8, ar 18.7.

kai: Action plan:
1) Rollback tokenizer in quantized image to v3_32k and push patch to build pipeline.
2) Run systematic ablation: (a) checkpoint change alone, (b) quant only (int8), (c) tokenizer only. Use the same eval harness.
3) Add token-length distribution checks to model onboarding gating (if avg_tok_len change > 10% for CJK flagged).
4) Investigate RTL postprocessing — check BiDi marks and normalization.

ada: I'll open PR for build rollback and include a unit test that ensures tokenizer artifact used in image matches model registry metadata.

yuki: For RTL, I'll add a small eval set with Hebrew/Arabic punctuation edge-cases and check grapheme preservation. Also propose we add a step to compare normalized NFC vs NFKC.

marta: Timeline? we need fix on staging by EOD tomorrow.

ada: Agree. I'll ship tokenizer rollback patch today and run full nightly eval. If quant still has >2 BLEU drop vs baseline on critical langs, we should fail the onboarding job.

kai: Also, let's avoid deploying redwood-v2.1 to Hosted until the ablation completes.

marta: Thanks — please ping #prod-notify once we have a green signal.

ada: pinging @kai for review on PR #4521.

kai: reviewing now. :thumbsup:
